title: What Does Each Ticket Status Mean
text:
## What Does Each Ticket Status Mean
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000649894
In the My Support Tickets module, each ticket includes a Status label so it’s easy to see where the request stands at a glance.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12174887591/original/g-D4OjOqfUM6-Pl7JhZ9Cahy_XCQvrvD1g.png?1771466322 | alt: ]
Use the All Statuses dropdown above the ticket list to filter by status and quickly focus on the tickets that matter right now.
Open
In Progress
Responded
Resolved
Closed
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12174888087/original/ZJK74-rq-cZ0dU9-AHrveKQaQxTEAO3RDQ.png?1771467551 | alt: ]

## Open
Your ticket has been sent, and is currently being worked on.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12174887772/original/PAoe5u_dx5lLEcau91sL9Sf2gCVUZOo-5w.png?1771466862 | alt: ]

## In Progress
This status is placed on a ticket when the development team is working on the resolution to what was reported in the ticket.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12174887823/original/zRofBGkZGA8MpiV6XLs7UJTn0Da-JTYqQQ.png?1771467010 | alt: ]

## Responded
Our support team has replied with a resolution or follow up questions.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12174887808/original/NdwOu56LesyePHwI7-hgvhpXafj7m2ArHw.png?1771466921 | alt: ]

## Resolved
Once a ticket is marked Resolved , the issue is considered ready to close out. If anything is still pending, reply to the ticket and it will automatically reopen; after 48 hours in Resolved , the ticket will move to Closed .
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12174887799/original/JdeDZASMAaRqQKJearnyR4aTCx8tll_eYQ.png?1771466906 | alt: ]

## Closed
The original issues that was submitted has been resolved and the ticket closed.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12174887801/original/X9fF02eC_UaLGDc-ijpCULSd3A2FdVK03Q.png?1771466911 | alt: ]

## Pending
Pending means the ticket is currently on hold while additional information or next steps are needed before it can move forward.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12174887775/original/9vlMThQdrmg8n7DWICYCeyVpXJDAJlA29w.png?1771466873 | alt: ]
